from solution import Find_Min_Length


def test_issue_example_from_description():
    """Example: Find_Min_Length([[1],[1,2]]) == 1."""
    expected = 1  # min(1, 2) = 1
    assert Find_Min_Length([[1], [1, 2]]) == expected


def test_issue_single_sublist():
    """Minimum length of a single sublist is its own length."""
    expected = 3  # min(3) = 3
    assert Find_Min_Length([[1, 2, 3]]) == expected


def test_issue_minimum_at_end():
    """Minimum length is found even when the shortest sublist is last."""
    expected = 1  # min(3, 2, 1) = 1
    assert Find_Min_Length([[1, 2, 3], [1, 2], [1]]) == expected


def test_issue_minimum_in_middle():
    """Minimum length is found even when the shortest sublist is in the middle."""
    expected = 1  # min(3, 1, 2) = 1
    assert Find_Min_Length([[1, 2, 3], [1], [1, 2]]) == expected


def test_issue_all_equal_lengths():
    """Minimum length when all sublists have the same length."""
    expected = 2  # min(2, 2, 2) = 2
    assert Find_Min_Length([[1, 2], [3, 4], [5, 6]]) == expected


def test_issue_empty_sublist_yields_zero():
    """Minimum length is zero when one sublist is empty."""
    expected = 0  # min(2, 0) = 0
    assert Find_Min_Length([[1, 2], []]) == expected


def test_issue_single_empty_sublist():
    """Minimum length of only an empty sublist is zero."""
    expected = 0  # min(0) = 0
    assert Find_Min_Length([[]]) == expected


def test_issue_minimum_two_among_larger():
    """Minimum length is 2 among longer sublists, not just 0 or 1."""
    expected = 2  # min(4, 3, 2) = 2
    assert Find_Min_Length([[1, 2, 3, 4], [1, 2, 3], [1, 2]]) == expected


def test_issue_length_independent_of_values():
    """Minimum length depends only on counts, not on element values."""
    expected = 1  # min(2, 1) = 1
    assert Find_Min_Length([["a", "b"], ["c"]]) == expected


def test_contract_result_is_int():
    """Contract: finding the minimum length must return an int."""
    result = Find_Min_Length([[1], [1, 2]])
    assert isinstance(result, int)


def test_contract_input_not_mutated():
    """Contract: finding the minimum length must not mutate the input."""
    data = [[1, 2], [3]]
    frozen = [[1, 2], [3]]
    Find_Min_Length(data)
    assert data == frozen
